expectedCodes.label: Kidney transplant status
expectedCodes.rationale: The note documents current transplant follow-up and stable status; the history specifies a kidney transplant, so Z94.0 applies rather than the unspecified-organ code Z94.9.

forbiddenCodes.reason: Unspecified organ transplant status; history specifies a kidney transplant.
Kidney transplant complication is not documented; the graft is stable.
CKD is not documented; creatinine 1.3 mg/dL is stable and no CKD stage is given.
Non-billable parent and CKD stage 3 is not documented.

requiredHistory.purpose: History supplies the organ (kidney) while the current note supplies the current transplant status.

grading.notes: Required codes are the gold set. Forbidden codes are hard errors. E/M codes matching ^99[2-4] are ignored because E/M assignment is out of scope.

notes: Tests history-derived specificity: the note says transplant but not which organ; history specifies kidney. The provenance check accepts the note snippet for status and records the history snippet for organ specificity.
